about.title: Gadgets that do what the box says
about.lead: Voltnest started after one too many 'fast chargers' that weren't fast and cables that died in a month.
paras: We test every product before it goes on sale — real charging speeds, real battery capacity, real bend tests — and we publish the numbers on the product page.
If something stops working within 12 months, we replace it. No forms, just a short video.
values: Every number on our pages is checked.
